name: Cosmo
note: Gloss metallic black with one shimmering galaxy stripe of deep blue, violet and magenta inlaid along the butt. Look from: Predator P3 Galaxy.

forearm.prompt: The forearm is glossy metallic black deep space (#0A0A12) with a shimmering galaxy stripe: a flowing river of nebula clouds in deep blue (#2B3FFF), violet (#8A2BE2) and magenta (#E040A0) that sweeps in a long S-curve along the middle row from left to right, glowing brighter in its core, with hundreds of tiny white and pale blue star specks and a few four-pointed sparkles. Near the left third, a small glassy violet planet orb about 60 pixels across. A thin violet line and a thin blue line curl through the space in elegant swirls. The two thin strips at the far left are the joint collar: paint them plain flat silver grey (#9A9EA6).

butt.prompt: Left thin strip (the ring): flat bright violet (#A45BFF). The wrap (from the ring to the next zone line): plain flat black (#101012). The butt sleeve (between the two zone lines on the right): glossy black deep space with a bright spiral galaxy on the middle row, about 220 pixels across: glowing magenta-white core (#E040A0) with spiral arms of violet (#8A2BE2) and blue (#2B3FFF) dust and tiny white stars all around. The very thin strip at the far right: plain black.

Trail.Note: The white wisp tinted (Config.Effects style row).

Pocket.Note: The default gust in the ball's colour.
